summary: No non-urgent branch is encoded (same-day referral criteria, vital-sign reassess thresholds), and several criteria are weakened: vomiting >= 2 becomes any vomiting, 'other injury' becomes 'Multiple injuries', pallor/muscle tightness are dropped, and suspected fractures are treated as definite. Core danger-sign lists for wound, fracture and head injury are otherwise well captured, with shock and concussion as probable diagnoses. Several SNOMED semantic tags (periorbital/postauricular ecchymosis, Fracture, open) were not verified.
